task_completion.description: CoppeliaSim application is launched and visible on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CoppeliaSim GUI window is open, showing the 3D simulation environment.

task_completion.description: Inverse Kinematics (IK) is configured for the robot arm to follow a path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The scene hierarchy or script editor shows IK elements (e.g., IK groups, targets, or tip dummies) being manipulated.

task_completion.description: At least 8 waypoints are defined for the linear weld trajectory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual markers for waypoints (dummies or path points) are visible in the 3D view, or code/logs show the creation of at least 8 distinct points.

task_completion.description: The robot executes the trajectory following the linear path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The robot arm is seen moving through the sequence of waypoints in the simulation window.

task_completion.description: The per-waypoint records are exported to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal window shows 'weld_trajectory.csv' exists in /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/.

task_completion.description: The trajectory summary statistics are exported to the specified JSON path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal window shows 'weld_stats.json' exists in /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the CoppeliaSim GUI rather than just using background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor or active window focus on the CoppeliaSim simulation controls and scene objects.

integrity.description: The trajectory data comes from a running simulation, not a pre-existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The simulation play button is active (pressed) and the simulation time counter is non-zero during the trajectory execution.

integrity.description: The trajectory covers a significant distance consistent with the 0.2m requirement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The visual distance covered by the robot end-effector in the 3D scene corresponds to a substantial portion of the chassis/workpiece.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must generate at least 8 waypoints and the total path length must be at least 0.2 meters. The output files must be saved exactly to /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/weld_trajectory.csv and /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/weld_stats.json. The simulation environment typically uses the 'obstacleAvoidanceAndIk.ttt' scene.
